# QS-CFW-8404-30 - Quality specification - flange blank CFW-8404-30 (4140)

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-8404-30

Scope
This quality specification applies to incoming and in-process flange blank CFW-8404-30 forgings manufactured from 4140 material at Plant P3. The document defines acceptance criteria, inspection requirements, and nonconformance handling for the forging blank configuration only.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Hardness | The hardness range for flange blank CFW-8404-30 (CFW-8404-30) is 33-38 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for flange blank CFW-8404-30 (CFW-8404-30) is ±0.08 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for flange blank CFW-8404-30 (CFW-8404-30) is 15.0 kg. |

Inspection method
Hardness verification shall be performed on representative samples taken from the finished blank face using a portable hardness tester calibrated per plant calibration procedures. Bore diameter inspection shall be performed using gauging appropriate to the bore geometry; measuring equipment shall be confirmed fit-for-purpose before use and zeroed per equipment procedure. Weight verification shall be performed on a calibrated weighing device capable of accommodating the blank geometry. Record results on the job traveler and attach inspection stamps to the associated lot documentation. Accept/reject decisions are made against the Requirements table.

Nonconformance handling
If a characteristic fails to meet the specified requirement, segregate the affected material and tag it as nonconforming. Notify Quality and Production control for disposition. Root cause analysis and containment actions shall be initiated to prevent further release of nonconforming forgings. Disposition options include rework to requirements, material reclassification if acceptable to customer, or scrap. Final disposition must be documented on the nonconformance record and retained with lot records.
